cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose up to one —
• Target creature becomes prepared. (Only creatures with prepare spells can become prepared.)
• Target creature becomes unprepared.
required_rule_paths: prepared_status_zone_independence: prepare is a creature-card property in ALL zones
become_prepared_trigger: entering prepared / triggered become-prepared creates the linked spell copy in exile
copy_controller: only the current permanent controller may cast the exile copy
cast_unprepares: casting the copy unprepares the creature
cast_a_copy_vs_copy_a_spell: cast triggers (e.g. Ishai, spellslinger) see a CAST spell, not a copied spell
cost_vs_value: copy has mana cost {0} for cost purposes; resolution uses the back-face spell text
zone_change_reset: creature leaving the battlefield loses prepared status; exile copy orphaning
target_legality: back-face targets chosen on cast; fizzle rules apply normally
commander_tax_interaction: commander tax applies to commander spell copies cast from exile
apnap_ordering: simultaneous become-prepared triggers across 4 players order APNAP
